def next_power_of_two(n: int) -> int:
    if n <= 0:
        raise ValueError("n must be positive")
    if n & (n - 1) == 0:
        return n
    v = n - 1
    v |= v >> 1
    v |= v >> 2
    v |= v >> 4
    v |= v >> 8
    v |= v >> 16
    shift = 32
    while (1 << shift) <= v:
        v |= v >> shift
        shift <<= 1
    return v + 1
